title: Provable Test-Time Scaling for Beam Search in LLM Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2609.38672v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Beam-search-based test-time methods provide an effective way to improve large language model (LLM) performance on long-horizon generation by pruning invalid reasoning paths early, leading to significantly improved reasoning efficiency and more favorable test-time cost scaling. Despite strong empirical success, the theoretical understanding of beam search remains limited. In this paper, we study the test-time compute guarantee of the commonly used beam search framework that uses the model's internal log-likelihood for intermediate scoring, while relying on an external reward model only after a complete response is generated. We first establish a lower bound for vanilla beam search, showing that at least $\Omega(C^\star(x)^2)$ samples are required for the optimal response to survive, where $C^\star(x)$ is the token-level coverage coefficient for prompt $x$. translated_title: 大语言模型推理中束搜索的可证明测试时扩展性
translated_abstract: 基于束搜索的测试时方法通过在早期剪除无效推理路径，为提升大语言模型（LLM）在长程生成任务上的表现提供了一种有效途径，显著提高了推理效率并带来了更有利的测试时成本扩展性。尽管在实证上取得了巨大成功，但针对束搜索的理论理解仍然有限。在本文中，我们研究了常用的束搜索框架的测试时计算保证，该框架使用模型内部的对数似然进行中间评分，而仅在生成完整回复后才依赖外部奖励模型。我们首先为原始束搜索建立了一个下界，表明最优回复要存活下来至少需要 $\Omega(C^\star(x)^2)$ 个样本，其中 $C^\star(x)$ 是提示 $x$ 的词元级覆盖系数。这促使我们提出了改进的置信度过滤束搜索（CF-Beam），该方法减少了……
tldr: 该论文首次为LLM推理中的束搜索建立了测试时计算的理论保证，证明了原始束搜索至少需要Ω(C*(x)²)量级的样本才能保留最优回复，并据此提出了置信度过滤束搜索（CF-Beam）以降低所需的样本量。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes the first provable test-time compute guarantees for beam search in LLM reasoning, showing that vanilla beam search requires at least Ω(C*(x)²) samples for the optimal response to survive, and proposes confidence-filtered beam search (CF-Beam) to reduce the required samples.
